### Video attribute bits

Background and overlay attribute byte:

| Bits | Field |
| --- | --- |
| 0-3 | `palette` |
| 4 | `flipX` |
| 5 | `flipY` |
| 6 | `priority` |
| 7 | `chrAlt` |

Sprite `ATTR` byte (OAM byte 3):

| Bits | Field |
| --- | --- |
| 0-3 | `palette` |
| 4 | `priority` |
| 5 | `flipX` |
| 6 | `flipY` |

Sprite `EXT` byte (OAM byte 4):

| Bits | Field |
| --- | --- |
| 0-1 | `xHigh` |
| 2 | `yHigh` |
| 3 | `disable` |
